abdomen-a02.source_reassessment: Nine additional axial CT planes (source z170 through210 every5 voxels) reviewed after the miss. Source o197 encloses solid pancreatic tissue; o277 follows the duodenal course around it, continuing inferior/transverse. These labels agree with the original individual source files. Pancreas median65 HU, no voxels below-200 HU; duodenum median58 HU with67 such voxels. Intensities are corroboration of source review, not solver evidence and not a standalone organ discriminator.
abdomen-a02.mask_only_support: The source pancreas occupies the concavity of the adjacent duodenal loop. The loop is clearer in isolated multi-view inspection than in the crowded whole scene; those public views and full masks were available. A03 independently resolved the same geometric relationship while given proposed names; that is corroboration of inferability with labels, not proof that anonymous recognition is uniquely determined.
